name: Natural Resources Careers Camp
org: Maryland Forestry Foundation with Allegany College of Maryland and the Maryland Forest Service
what_you_do: Spend a week in Garrett County exploring natural resources careers and college paths. Only 42 spots are open.
who_can_apply: Students who are in, going into, or just finished high school. The page lists no grades or minimum age.
pay_detail: $500 tuition covers lodging and meals. Local Forestry Boards typically sponsor it for Maryland students. $150 activity fee ($153.50 by PayPal).
deadline_text: Applications for 2027 are open. Camp is July 18 to 24, 2027, limited to 42 students. No closing date is posted; apply early.
how_to_apply: Be free the whole week. Fill out the online application. A parent signs and sends the signature pages. Have two adults who are not family send letters of support. Your local Forestry Board does a short interview and makes the choice. Pay the activity fee if asked.
notes: You must be 16 or older by the end of camp to earn the optional two college credits. Credit has extra fees. Families arrange their own rides.
